text:
nina: FYI deploying r-2026.03.22c. We need to toggle feature `hf_multitenant_routing` with an emergency hold plan. Change window 01:00-02:00 UTC. Keeping it conservative: 0% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with silent hold points. ping @sre :eyes:

rob: ack. Can you publish rollback thresholds? prefer clear numeric triggers so ops can act fast.

nina: Rollback triggers agreed:
- 5xx spike > 0.7% sustained for 4m
- p95 > 2x baseline for 6m
- token-cost index > +25% for 10m
If any breach -> set flag to 0% and pin to `model-hf-v1.9` fallback.

kai: I'll own QA smoke checks at each step and post quick diffs. If any eval fails, we hold and do not progress.

deploy-bot: INFO: scheduled flag ramp for `hf_multitenant_routing` at 01:10 UTC by nina. Will post updates.

sre-bot: NOTE: temp monitors live. Alerts to #eng-oncall and @rob.

nina: Ops quick commands for emergency:
```
# immediate stop
curl -X POST https://internal-api/flags/hf_multitenant_routing/override -d '{"percent":0}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP"

# fast partial rollback
rwdctl flags set hf_multitenant_routing --percent 25 --reason "partial-hold"
```

rob: I'll watch 01:08-01:30. If I see any bounce I'll call rollback.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 01:11 UTC: ramped to 25%.

kai: QA 01:15 UTC: smoke PASS. minor metric drift +1.2% on one case.

sre-bot: Telemetry 01:18 UTC: p95 130ms (baseline 120), 5xx 0.2%, token-cost 1.04. Within limits.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 01:25 UTC: ramped to 75%.

kai: QA 01:28 UTC: PASS. no regressions.

rob: 01:33 UTC quick scan: p95 145ms, 5xx 0.25%. still safe. proceeding to full.

deploy-bot: UPDATE 01:36 UTC: ramped to 100%. Rollout complete.

nina: I'll remove pins at 01:45 UTC and update release notes: "r-2026.03.22c: enabled hf_multitenant_routing via staged ramp; rollback criteria and emergency commands documented."

sre-bot: NOTE: temporary monitors will expire in 3h. Extend if needed.
